parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true: `PlaycutMetadataMockCache.set` in `PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift` and `EntityResolverMockCache.set` in `DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift` are test-only mock cache implementations. Although their `set` methods share a near-duplicate shape (Jaccard 0.7), each mock is scoped to its own distinct test fixture class (`PlaycutMetadataMockCache` vs. `EntityResolverMockCache`) exercising different subsystems under test. Consolidating them would couple unrelated test suites and obscure the intent of each fixture.
